subject: Term incentive structuring and step-up pricing
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@orionhealth.ai>
To: michael.grant@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Exploring multi-year prepay + step-up ramp options

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We want to move from pilot to a committed deployment but need clarity on pricing if we do a 2- or 3-year prepay. Key asks from our side: 

- Price run-rate for a 2-year vs 3-year prepaid commitment (annualized).
- A step-up (ramp) schedule for usage: Year 1 conservative, Year 2 + Year 3 growth assumptions.
- Any true-up or carry-forward mechanics (we expect seasonal swings).
- Overages and cap mechanics if we spike.

We are evaluating a 3-year proposal with a larger discount, but procurement has asked for a clear SLA credit floor if they accept a higher discount. Attached is our projected consumption template (high-level). Can you put together options we can share with procurement?

Cheers,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of AI Infrastructure
Orion Health
[Attachment: Orion_Health_Demand_Template.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: michael.grant@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@orionhealth.ai>
Cc: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring multi-year prepay + step-up ramp options

Liam —

Appreciate the template. Quick summary of two structured options we can support (high level — final numbers subject to finance sign-off):

Option A — 24-month prepay (annualized):
- ~12% discount vs list for an annualized prepay (paid up front per year).
- 12-month true-up window (60-day settlement) and 10% carry-forward cap to Year 2.
- Overages billed at 1.25x list rate, with a soft cap we can negotiate based on final commit.

Option B — 36-month prepay (annualized):
- ~17.5% discount vs list (reflects deeper commitment).
- Yearly true-up (annual) with a 5% carry-forward allowance; one-time true-up at contract anniversaries.
- SLA credit floor of 2.5% for availability misses tied to the dedicated tier.

If Orion pushes for a 20%+ discount on a 3-year term, I’ll need a formal approval from revenue ops + finance and an explicit non-refundable prepay clause. I’ve attached the demand template back to you with a few of our assumptions populated. If you want, we can sketch a stepped ramp in the contract (Q1 Year1 floor, Year2 2x floor, Year3 3x floor) and tie pricing breakpoints to those steps.

Next steps: if you like Option B, can you confirm the rough committed spend and whether procurement needs the SLA credit written as a cap or as an offset? I’ll loop in finance for formal pricing.

—Michael
Michael Grant
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0172

From: michael.grant@redwood.ai
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Exploring multi-year prepay + step-up ramp options — request for approval

Neha / Marissa,

Looping you on Orion Health — they prefer a 3-year prepay and have asked for a discount in the 20% neighborhood. I recommended 17.5% as a reasonable anchor but want guidance on conditions we should require to approve ~20% (if we decide to). Key details:
- Deal id: DEAL-4891; projected annualized spend Year1 ~ $1.2M (growing to ~$3.5M by Year3 under their ramp).
- They expect an annual true-up; procurement wants an explicit SLA credit floor in the contract for high discount levels.
- They submitted a demand template (attached) with seasonal spikes; our standard carry-forward policy would cap at 5–10% depending on the term.

Proposal options for approval:
A) Approve 17.5% for 3Y with standard Annual true-up, 5% carry-forward, SLA credit floor 2.5% AND non-refundable first-year prepay.
B) Approve up to 20% for 3Y IF they accept: non-refundable full prepay, 12-month irrevocable commitment (no early termination), and an SLA credit ceiling (max 5% credit). Also require finance to run IRR checks.

Please see attached draft pricing memo for quick math. I need a go/no-go by Thursday EOD to keep the procurement timeline.

Thanks,
—Mike
[Attachment: pricing_memo_Orion_3yr.pdf (memo)]

From: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
To: michael.grant@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Exploring multi-year prepay + step-up ramp options — request for approval

Mike,

Approve Option A (17.5% for 3Y) with the following mandatory conditions:
1) Non-refundable prepay for Year 1 at signature (we can split payment across the first 90 days if needed for cashflow).
2) Annual true-up with a 5% carry-forward allowance only. Any carry-forward above 5% requires pre-approval from Rev Ops.
3) SLA credit floor at 2.5% and ceiling at 5% tied to the Dedicated SLA. Credits are the sole remedy for availability misses (no termination right).
4) Insert a conditional quantization / model-variant clause: if Orion moves to a quantized model variant that materially reduces cost, pricing will be revisited at the next anniversary (protects future economics).
5) Finance to validate IRR and sign off on the final quote before sending to procurement.

We will not approve 20%+ unless procurement accepts the stricter non-refundable and IRR-reviewed terms. If Orion insists on more discount, escalate to revenue leadership with a clear tradeoff sheet.

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

From: michael.grant@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@orionhealth.ai>
Cc: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring multi-year prepay + step-up ramp options — Proposed agreement

Liam —

Thanks for the patience. We’ve signed off internally on a 36-month prepay structure at a 17.5% annualized discount with the following terms (summary below). This reflects an approval from RevOps and will be subject to finance sign-off on the final quote: 

- Commitment: 36-month prepaid contract, annualized pricing applied.
- Discount: 17.5% off list, applied to committed volumes.
- Prepay mechanics: Year 1 prepay is non-refundable at signature. We can accept a two-step payment for Year 1 across the first 90 days to help procurement cashflow.
- True-up: Annual true-up on anniversary with a 5% carry-forward allowance. Anything above 5% carry-forward requires prior RevOps approval.
- Overages: Billed at 1.25x list beyond committed volumes.
- SLA: Availability credit floor 2.5% and ceiling 5%; credits are the exclusive remedy for availability misses.
- Contract clause: Conditional pricing review if Orion adopts materially different model execution (e.g., quantized serving) at anniversary.

Next steps: I’ve attached the pricing memo and included a DocuSign link for the term sheet. If this structure works, please confirm committed annualized spend and we’ll issue the formal agreement. Procurement: once you confirm, we’ll route the DocuSign and set a target signature window of 7 business days.

DocuSign (term sheet): https://www.docusign.com/en/recipient/XXXX-ORION-4891
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4891

Regards,
Mike
